content.title: ESC Declaration of Interest Report
content.guideline: 2020 ESC Guidelines for the management of adult congenital heart disease
content.summary: Statement describing ESC conflict of interest policy for guideline authors: mandatory yearly Declaration of Interest (DOI) submission, assessment of DOIs prior to work commencing, and possible exclusion of experts based on defined criteria.
policy_references: ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy
2012 ESC Policy statement : Relations between professional medical associations and the health-care industry, concerning scientific communication and continuing medical education
disqualifying_characteristics: Part-time employment or salary (if related to guideline topic)
Stock ownership (if related to guideline topic)
Holding of a patent which generates revenues (if related to guideline topic)
Receipt of royalties for intellectual property (if related to guideline topic)
additional_disqualifying_characteristics: Personally received payments from healthcare industry of 10,000€ or higher per year
Payments from healthcare industry of 10,000€ or higher per year made to one’s institution/hospital or to other legal bodies which have generated a direct or indirect personal benefit/asset
content.notes: All DOIs are assessed prior to work commencing; ESC may exclude experts from guideline activities based on exclusion criteria related to the guideline topic.
